notes: Checked the main mega-menu JSON embedded in the homepage RSC payload: SALE (categoryId 12938, /c/sale) is the only sale/discount-type top-level nav item; its own groupData sub-groups are WOMEN CLOTHING, MEN CLOTHING, HOME & DECOR, JEWELRY, and every leaf link under it uses an 'eoss-' (End-of-Season-Sale) URL prefix (e.g. eoss-sale-home-decor-living, eoss-women-kurtas). Opened https://www.jaypore.com/c/sale?page=1&fp%5B%5D=Gender__fq%3AHome+Decor directly with Playwright: the on-page heading literally reads 'EOSS SALE' (breadcrumb Home > Sale), 1269 products, every product shown with a percent-off discount badge (e.g. '54% OFF', '39% OFF', '33% OFF') and 'Inclusive of GST benefit' messaging tied to a named festive/seasonal promotion banner ('This Festive Season, Get GST Benefits...') -- this is textbook temporary seasonal promotional-sale framing with no permanence/outlet/clearance signal anywhere on the page or in its breadcrumb/taxonomy. Exhaustively grepped sitemap-categories.xml (5727 URLs) for clearance/outlet/final-sale/end-of-line/discontinued/liquidation/stock-clearance keywords: zero matches. Also grepped broadly for 'eoss' (31 matches: eoss_2024, eoss-2025, eoss-home, eoss-under-5000, eoss-express-shipping-2025, eoss-bestseller, eoss-hotsellers, etc.) -- every one is a dated/seasonal End-of-Season-Sale sub-collection; none is described anywhere as permanent outlet/clearance/discontinued stock. The footer and every homepage CMS section (Home Banner Carousel, Reclaim Your Roots, Popular Categories, Jaypore Features, Featured Collections, Jaypore Finest, Brand Spotlight, Jaypore Craft Treasures, Skinny Banner) carry no Clearance/Outlet link either. Conclusion per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test: Jaypore's only sale-type merchandising ('SALE' / 'EOSS SALE') is a generic, named, temporary seasonal promotional campaign with no site-taxonomy permanence signal -- it does not qualify as Clearance, and no ambiguous borderline case was found either. Access: direct HTTPS fetch worked for HTML/robots.txt/sitemap with no block and no Claude-specific disallow; Playwright (tier 2) was used to render the exact /c/sale product count and heading text since the live grid loads client-side via an internal API (same constraint the prior Home-Decor pass hit). No genuine Clearance/Outlet PLP exists on this site.
